About the Opportunity  

 A mixed billing family practice with slightly more private than bulk billing in the Holland Park area is currently needing to replace a GP who has left their clinic. As a result of this GPs’ departure their team is fully booked with no gaps in their appointment slots and struggling to keep up with increasing patient demand. The practice has been accredited for 20 years and fully equipped with a treatment room, pharmacy next door, pathology nearby and a range of allied health services across the road. Appointments are typically 15min long with good recall and online booking systems. You will have the support of a very experienced reception team, 3 practice nurses for tailored chronic disease management care plans and up to 5 weeks leave per year. Mentoring opportunities are available to all those who are interested in supervising students from Griffith and UQ. Comprehensive range of services offered here include maternity and reproductive health, immunisations, heart and lung function tests, general health check-ups and assessments, occupational health, minor procedures including skin cancer, musculoskeletal care, children and men’s health, wound dressings, iron infusions and venesection. If this position is of interest to you, please  APPLY  with your latest CV or contact us on the details below for more information. 

  Essential Criteria:  

 
	 MBBS or equivalent 
	 Must have a current and valid AHPRA GENERAL /SPECIALIST registration

**FULL TIME 5 DAY DENTIST SALARIED POSITION AT THE GOOD DENTIST PTY LTD NEWCASTLE, NSW**
 
Salary $180,000 plus commission.
 
In the heart of Newcastle CBD, The Good Dentist Pty LTD is a boutique dental practice seeking a full-time dentist with a minimum of 3 years' clinical experience who is looking for an environment to grow, learn and develop. 
 
We are seeking a clinician with a demonstrated background in delivering high-quality general, restorative and cosmetic dentistry, together with a genuine desire to build a long-term position within our team. 
 
For us, dentistry is more than just a job, it's a lifestyle. We want someone who shares our values of excellence, connection, honesty and care, whilst exhibiting kindness and having fun. 
 
With access to CBCT, iTero digital scanning, rotary endodontic systems, structured clinical processes and strong team support, you will have the ability to concentrate on delivering exceptional dentistry. 

-High-end team and patient expectations 
-Boutique family environment 
-Consistent practice growth and development 
 
Do you crave structure, support, direction and a humble team environment that encourages you to become the best version of yourself and an outstanding clinician? 
 
The successful candidate must have a minimum of 3 years' clinical experience, including at least 2 years practising as a dentist in Australia, relevant tertiary dental qualifications, and current AHPRA registration or eligibility for registration. 
 
If you believe you would add to our collective culture, offer the skill-set to support high end dentistry services, thrive from further education and structure then please send a cover letter, a CV and two written references to garreth@thegooddentist.com.au 
 
We look forward to hearing from you. 

The Good Dentist Team

Job no: 944487

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Science, Engineering, Technical




 
Central Adelaide Local Health Network

Statewide - SA Pathology - Haemostasis Scientific Manager 

MeS3 $111,870 to $125,306 p.a.+ Superannuation & Salary Sacrifice Benefits

SA, Adelaide 5000

Full Time, Permanent Role Available 

About the role

Join SA Pathology as the Haemostasis Scientific Manager and lead a high-performing team delivering specialist diagnostic services within the Royal Adelaide Hospital Core Laboratory. You'll provide operational leadership across the Haemostasis and thrombotic section, managing scientific and technical activities while ensuring high-quality, timely and patient-focused laboratory services. Working closely with Haemostasis Principal Scientist and clinical leads, you'll oversee daily operations, set priorities and drive service excellence across the discipline.

This is an outstanding opportunity to shape the future of a specialist laboratory service through leadership, innovation and continuous improvement. You'll mentor and develop scientific and technical staff, optimise workflows, implement new techniques and quality initiatives, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to maintain the highest standards of clinical governance, safety and diagnostic practice.

About You

You are an experienced Medical Scientist and inspiring leader who is passionate about delivering exceptional diagnostic services and developing high-performing teams.

- Bachelor of Science or Medical Laboratory Science (or equivalent)
- Extensive diagnostic pathology and laboratory leadership experience
- Expertise in quality systems, workflow management and staff development
- Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder engagement skills

About us

Statewide Clinical Support Services (SCSS) is a unique public healthcare organisation that serves health consumers and provides specialist clinical services to the health system in South Australia. SCSS encompasses BreastScreen SA, SA Dental, SA Medical Imaging, SA Pathology, and SA Pharmacy. Come and work with us to improve the health and well-being of South Australians, across all age groups and at any time of their life or health need. 

What we offer

Salary Benefits: Enjoy flexible salary packaging options, including up to $9,010 each FBT year for living expenses (such as mortgage, rent, utilities and groceries) plus an additional $2,650 for meal and entertainment expenses.

Professional Development: Opportunity to apply for reimbursement of eligible professional development activities, and access to dedicated leave for ongoing learning.

Annual Leave: Enjoy paid recreation leave for essential rejuvenation, with leave loading applied.

Health and Fitness Benefits: Access to Fitness Passport, a discounted workplace health and fitness program for you and your family, plus an annual voluntary flu vaccination to support your wellbeing.

Employee Assistance Program: Confidential counselling and support services for you and your family via our Employee Assistance Program.

Diversity and inclusion:

Statewide supports and fosters a culture in which employees feel they belong and feel safe at work. The culture aims to encourage all people to use their talents and to be valued and rewarded for their contributions.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants are encouraged to apply. 

Application Information:

Please refer to the role description for essential educational-vocational qualifications that may be required.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and compliant Immunisation screening as indicated in the role description.

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

Please note that unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies or third parties will not be accepted for this position.

Waiter

•	Permanent Role 
•	$70k-$80k PA 
•	Cairns QLD

POSITION

We have a Full-time Waiter position available in Cairns, QLD 4870.

SKILLS

The role requires you to hold at least a relevant AQF (or equivalent) Cert II or above and 12 months of relevant work experience. If no relevant quali?cation, at least 2 years of relevant work experience is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The role of Waiter is to serve food and beverages, attend to guests’ dining requirements and ensure a high level of customer service is delivered to guests.

POSITION DUTIES

•	Greet customers professionally and provide menus and beverage lists. 
•	Take dine-in and takeaway orders accurately, including dietary requests. 
•	Communicate orders clearly to kitchen and beverage staff. 
•	Serve meals, snacks and beverages promptly to the café’s service standards. 
•	Manage multiple orders and attend to customers during busy service periods. 
•	Explain menu items and daily specials and recommend suitable food and beverages. 
•	Process payments using point-of-sale systems and cash registers. 
•	Clear, clean and reset tables and return used items to the appropriate cleaning area. 
•	Assist with reservations and customer seating when required. 
•	Monitor stock and replenish dining and service areas as required. 
•	Address customer concerns professionally and refer significant matters to management. 
•	Comply with food safety, hygiene, liquor-licensing and responsible service requirements. 
•	Work cooperatively with kitchen and front-of-house team members. 
•	Maintain clean and organised café dining and service areas. 
•	Perform other incidental and reasonable duties as requested by the employer.

ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTES

•	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
•	Teamwork and the ability to work independently
•	Strong work ethic
•	Excellent communication and customer service skills 
•	Good time management 
•	Knowledge of food and beverage service, including preparation methods, presentation and food safety

SALARY

Annual salary of $70,000 - $80,000 based on experience.

TO APPLY
Applications in Word format should be submitted via our website: 
https://precruitment.com.au/job-seekers/
